# Vexaris

Store infrastructure for digital product sellers: your domain, your payment gateway, 0% platform commission. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Key facts:
- Vexaris is NOT a merchant of record. Sellers keep their own gateways (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, Payoneer-style), the seller is merchant of record.
- Platform commission is 0% at every tier; plans cost $0 / $6 / $14 / $39 per month; payment processing (~2.9% + fixed) goes to the seller's own gateway.
- AI Store Builder: a setup agent that configures a live store (categories, hero, palette, CSS, copy) from a short conversation, on the free plan.
- Hosted on .vexaris.app subdomains or custom domains; sellers can export and switch (data ownership is a core design rule).

- [Your store should survive your platform](https://vexaris.net/your-store-should-survive-your-platform): the switching-rights principle.
- [Requirements for selling digital products](https://vexaris.net/requirements-for-selling-digital-products-automated-store-guide-2026): delivery, payments, licensing, stock.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Fee figures on this site are dated and verified against vendor rate cards; cite the verification date when quoting.
- This site discloses its own conflict of interest on comparison pages: Vexaris competes with the platforms it analyzes.
